tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pas/ dang por skad cig gis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐ du bsams te/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas spros/ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐ zhes pas bsdus pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de spraus 'dus pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'gying bag dang ldan par bsam | de'i lte bar hūm̐ gcig bsam de rtsa dbu ma nas byung ste klad pa'i rgyas la byon | sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon te mdun gyi nam mkhar yi ge hūm̐ sbrel ma zhig tu gyur to/ /de nas badz+ra dhṛ ka ces pas hūm̐ gcig bye nas bdag la thim pas bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gnas pa de zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur te/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing nag phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon dang pos dril bu/ bar ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang rin po che/ tha ma gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri bsnams pa/ zhal khro la 'dzum pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku ru snang ba ma yin pa'i yum dang bcas par bsgom mo/ /de nas ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal zhes pas lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil dang sor mo rnams la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re bsam mo | | a tsaṇ+d+ra maṇ+ḍal zhes g.yon pa'i mthil dang sor mo rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re bsam/ de nas g.yas pa'i mthil du hūm̐/ sor mo la oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā zhes pa bsam/ g.yon pa'i mthil du a/ sor mo la yum lnga'i sa bon bsam | de las yab yum bcur gyur te/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas thal mo sbyar te brdas bskul/ badz+ra añja li hūm̐/ zhes sor mo bsnol bas rjes su zhugs/ badz+ra ban+dha zhes pas sor mo brdabs te gcig tu gyur/ oṃ badz+ra añja li zhes pa la sogs pas yab yum du bskyed pas sbyor ba'i mtshams nas khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa mang po byung ste/

lag mthil du hūm̐ dang a la thim/ de nas a zhes brjod pas yang khro chung thams cad spros pas de rnams kyis dgra dang bgegs thams cad hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa rngam pa'i sgra dang bcas te bskrad par bsam/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de rnams 'dus te 'od du zhu nas bdag gi thugs kar thim par bsam/ de nas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bdag gi sna bug nas byung ste mdun du bsam/ de nas oṃ bh+rūṃ hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa brjod pas phyogs nas mtshon cha babs pas mdun na mar la thim pas me'i phung po ltar 'bar zhing ri'i phung po tsam du bsam la/ de re re nas rim pas blangs par bsam stai rang rang gi phyag rgyas bcings te mtshams bcad do/ /yang ngag tu hūm̐ nga'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa la sogs pa gzhug badz+ra yak+ṣa la sogs pa'i sngags re re brjod de g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs rnams bskrad de ra bar gyur | g.yon nas bskor te phaṭa bzhag ste hūm̐ yan chad brjod pas mtshon cha'i gur du gyur nas bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsam mo/ /phyag rgya ni gung mo bsrangs te mdzub mo gzhan phyogs bzhi nas btsugs pa ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ / mdzub mo bkug ste mthe bong gis mnan nas gzhan brkyang ba ni ral gri'i phyag rgya'o | | thal mo sbyar te sor mo'i rtse mo bsnol ba ni 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ / sor mo rnams rtse sprad de srin lag gnyis nang du bkug pa ni rgya gram gyi phyag rgya'o | | sor mo'i rtse mo rnams bkug ste mgo bo ltar byas pa ni dbyug to'i phyag rgya'o | | phyag rgya de rnams bcing zhing steng yang rdo rje'i zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig ces pa'i mgor/ steng yang ral gri zhes pa la sogs pa bcug la rim pa lngar mtshams bcad do/ /de nas srid pa'i rtse mo zhes pa nas dengs shig pa'i bar brjod pas shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ de nas rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma la raṃ bsams te/

g.yas pa'i spyan zur ces pa nas 'asreg pa'i bar brjod do/ /raṃ zhes brjod de mig bzlog pas raṃ gyi 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bsreg par bsam ste thal bar bun song bar bsam/ g.yon par zla ba la a bsams te/ g.yon pa'i spyan zur zhes pa nas gso bar bya ba'i bar brjod de/ a zhes pa dang g.yon pa zlog pas a'i 'od zer byang chub kyi sems kyis thal ba la sngar bzhin gsol bar bsam/ des mtshams lnga yang snang la rang bzhin med pa gzha' tshon lta bur bsam mo/ /dang po mtshams bcad pa'o/ /de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥzhes brjod pa dang*/ se gol lcags kyu dang bcas pa brdabs pas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma dang tha mi dad kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ de yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa badz+ra kī la ya'i ngo bor bsdus la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam mo/ / dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa mngon par bsam/ de'i 'khor na ye shes dang las las grub pa la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro dang dpa' bo thams cad ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa thams cad kyang sprin phung tsam du bsam la/ de'i spyan sngar rang gi sdig sgrib sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir brjod med dang dam tshig nyi shu pas bshags/ nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir mkha' 'gro rnams la'ang bshags pa byas la gsol ba gdab/ de nas a la la ho zhes pa'i tshogs kyis byin phab la/ rnga dang dril bu la sogs pa sgra dang bcas pa brjod de/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ gis rang gi thugs kar bstim mo/ /de nas dam rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ dmar po zhig 'phros te/ bdud rtsi'i snod la reg pas me'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ mi gtsang ba dang lhag ma la sogs pa bsreg par bsam/ yam̐ zhig 'phros pas rlung gis gtor bar bsam/ kham̐ zhig 'phros pas chus bkrus te dag par bsam/ de nas bh+rūm̐ zhig 'phros te de las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod shin tu che bar bsam/

de'i nang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa zhig gi lte ba la nyi ma gnyis bsam/ de bzhin du shar du zla ba la oṃ dkar po gnyis/ lhor rin po che la swā ser po gnyis/ nub du pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po gnyis/ byang du a gru gsum la hā ljang gu gnyis bsam | de nas badz+ra rat+na zhes pa la sogs pa brjod pas dbus kyi hūm̐ de las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ shar du oṃ las 'khor lo dang dril bu/ lhor swā las rin po che dang dril bu/ nub tu ā las pad+ma dang dril bu/ byang du hā las ral gri dang dril bur gyur to/ /de la rkyen gyi sngags hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛ ka ces pa la sogs pa brjod pas dbus kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum/ shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa yab yum du gyur to/ /de'i steng du yi ge bh+rūṃ gsum/ de nas bdag gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi steng du rta mgrin yab yum skad cig gis bsam/ de gnyis sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang chub kyi sems de yi ge 'bru gsum la phog de gsum yang 'od du zhu ste rgyal ba yab yum bcu la phog pas yab yum bcu sbyor ba'i brdas bskul te/ sa ma ya ho zhes pa la sogs pa brjod pas sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod bcud la khyab pa bsdus te bdud rtsi la thim pas 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du dkar ltem mer bsams la/ gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod do/ /de nas g.yas su gtor bas bgegs bskrad/ g.yon du gtor bas rdzas dang yo byad bsrung bar bsam mo/ /gtor ma'i dus su bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag cig spros pas rtog sgrib dang bag chags bsregs te mi dmigs par bsam | yang oṃ dmar po zhig 'phros pas de zhu/ 'phros pas snod bcud kyi rtse bcud bsdus te bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ yang oṃ zhes brjod pas oṃ gyi 'phro 'dus bdud rtsi de nyid kyang ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba lnga'i bdag nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga dang ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam

| de la oṃ zhes pas 'od longs spyod du bsam mo/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags bdun brjod do/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom par bya ste/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni dngos po'i gnas lugs shes bya'i 'dug tshul chos nyid ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin pa la de ltar bsgom pa ni de bzhin nyid do/ /des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing de'i ngang las ma 'das pa ni kun tu snang ba yin te/ de ltar chos can thams cad la yod pa'i chos nyid de rang chas su gnas kyang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can dag re snying rje nam mkha'i ngo bor bsgom ste/ de ni kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / rdo rje khros pa zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas mtshon chen zhes pa nas bsgom par bya zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni gong du de bzhin nyid ni shes rab/ kun snang ni thabs te/ de gnyis kyis rang gi shes pa'i rgyud dag par byas nas thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang rig pa gsal ba ma 'gags pa ci yang ma yin pa de yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag cig tu bsgom/ de ni rnam shes kyi ngo bo byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin de rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rgyu'o/ /de nas dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya ste/ hūm̐ de las yi ge ram̐ dmar po zhig chad de/ 'od 'phros 'dus pa las me'i dkyil 'khor tu gyur te/ sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang snod kyi ljan ljin thams cad bsreg par bsam/ yam̐ zhes pas yam̐ dud kha chad de 'phros pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor du gyur te 'khor ba'i skyon de gtor bar bsam/ kham̐ zhes pas kham̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te bkrus te dag par bsam/ de ltar ma dag pa 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad sbyangs la dag pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya ste/

hūm̐ las 'og gi phyogs su ha ljang gu gcig 'phros te/ ha karma rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dbang chen rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po rgya gram gyi dbyibs gru gsum sra zhing 'thas pa rab gnon gyi bu'i mthu'am/ tshan po che'i rdo rje'i mthu yang thal bar byed par bskyed do/ / de'i steng du hūm̐ las kham̐ dkar po 'phros te/ kham̐ kha sa me zhes brjod pas chu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur to/ /yang rlung las sum̐ ser po 'phros pa las sum̐ ni ri ti zhes pas gser gyi sa gzhi chen por gyur te/ mtsho la dar chags par gyur to/ / de'i steng du hūm̐ las ram̐ dmar po 'phros pa las ram̐ ram̐ me zhes brjod pas me'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ me phyed thur du thim pas 'byung ba drod kyi cha mnyam/ phyed yar byung bas 'byung ba lnga'i mtha' la 'ja' tshon sna lngas bskor bar bsam mo | | de'i steng du hūm̐ las e mthing skya zhig 'phros te/ am̐ bh+rūṃ zhes brjod pas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ yum kun tu bzang mo'i mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /de yang spyir khyab par bsgom ste/ rgyud las/ nam mkha' spyir khyab pho brang gzhal yas khang*/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /'byung ba bzhi po'ang yum bzhi'i mkhar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas yang bh+rūṃ las ra dmar nag bzhi 'phros te/ ra rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs pa zhing gi gnas rgyu ba dbus mtho na mtha' dma' ba/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma' ba lta bur gyur to/ /de'i steng du keṃ sngon po chad pa las keṃ ni ri ti dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal zhes brjod pas/ keng rus kyi ri rab dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug khri zheng dang dpangs su yod par rak+ta'i nang du brgyad khri nub ste/ yar brgyad khri 'phags pa sked pa nas nyi zla 'khor zhing 'bar ba brtan zhing mi g.yo ba'i phyir grwa bzhi nas gnam lcags kyi gzer chen btab pa/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi mngon du byung ste mtshan par bskyed do/

/de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ smug nag gcig chad de/ bh+rūṃ bi shud+dhe dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rin po che lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zhi ba'i pho brang du bskyed de/ de yang shar shel dkar po las grub pa/ lho gser/ nub byi ru/ byang in+d+ra nī la las grub pa/ dbus bai ḍūr+ya sngon po/ shar na shel gyi rdo rje dkar po'i ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ gral ma dang*/ phyam yod pa/ lho gser gyi rin po che'i ka ba dang*/ gdung gnyis/ gral bu la sogs pa thams cad kyang gser gyi rin po che las byas pa/ nub tu byi ru dmar po las grub pa'i pad+ma'i ka ba gnyis dang*/ gdung dang*/ gral bu dang*/ phyam dang*/ byang du in+d+ra nī la las byas pa'i ral gri'i ka ba gnyis dang*/ gdung dang*/ phyam dang | gral bu shar gyi gdung gis nub kyi ka ba la sleb nus kyi/ gdung bre gnyis kyis kyang shar gyi ka ba la sleb pa'o/ /byang dang lhor yang de ltar ro/ / steng na bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i rgya phub rtse mo rdo rje nor bu phyur bur byas pa/ shar shel gyi sgo/ lho gser/ nub by-i ru/ byang in+d+ra nī la'i sgo/ sgo bzhi na rta babs dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin ni chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can de'i phyi ljang gu/ de'i phyi na dmar po/ de'i phyi na ser po/ tha ma na dkar pos bskor ba/ kha khyer la rin po che'i do shal dang za ra tshags 'phyang ba rmang na gzhi stegs dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi nang med par gsal ba/ gzhi stegs de'i kha na yar gzugs kyi rdo rje dkar mo me long thogs pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi na sgra'i lha mo pi wang dang gling bu thogs pa sngon mos bskor ba/ dri'i lha mo ser mo spos khang la sogs pa thogs pa/ de'i phyi na ro'i lha mo dmar mo zhal zas bsnams pa/ reg gi lha mo ljang gu'am khra mo na bza' bsnams pas bskor ba'o || gzhan yang tā la'i skye shing dang khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/

ma btab pa'i lo tog la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rim rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ me'i 'od kyis bskor ba'o/ /de'i dbus su hūm̐ las 'od mthing nag 'phros pa las e gru gsum 'bar ba/ bang rim sum brtsegs dang bcas pa rdo rje ra ba mu khyud dang bcas pa | de'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa gnyis steng 'og tu zug pa'i rtsibs mchan e gru gsum res mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rim bar khyams gnyis la phyogs re re na glo 'bur gnyis gnyis te bcu drug yod par bskyed do/ /gzhal yas khang de'i nang du dbus su hūm̐ las mam̐ 'phros/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal zhes pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor | a las a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal zhes pas zla ba'i gdan/ pam̐ las pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal zhes pas pad+ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du ma hā de wa dzaḥzhes pa dang*/ u ma de wī dzaḥzhes pas dbang phyug pho mo byi bcings su gdan du bting ngo*/ /phyag len du skabs 'dir khro bo la sogs pa'i gdan yang bskyed do/ /da ni brten pa lha bskyed par bya ste/ dbus kyi lte ba la dbang phyug pho mo'i snying gar hūm̐ de babs pas drag po'i phrin las yin pas rtsa sngags tsam gyis bskyed zer/ yang na hūm̐ las spros pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de 'phros 'dus pa las rtsa sngags sgra'i tshul du byung ba las skur bskyed de/ zhal gsum phyag drug

g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing nag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu | bar ma rdo rje rtse lnga/ g.yon dang po me dpung*/ bar ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tha ma gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang | zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ stag gi sham thabs can/ sbrul dkar khras dbu rgyan byas pa/ dmar khras se ral kha byas pa/ ljang khras skaid chings byas pa/ nag khras rkang gdub dang lag gdub byas pa/ thod pa rlon pa'i do shal du byas pa/ thod skam gyi thod phreng du byas pa/ gzhan yang rak+ta'i thig le dang | zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa'o/ /zhi ba'i cha lugs rdzogs pa'i rtags su rin po che'i dpung rgyan dang gdub bu dang mgul rgyan la sogs pas kyang brgyan pa'o/ /de nas snying rje zhes pa'i tshigs bcad brjod de/ /rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched/ skra nyi khri chig stong*/ ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang 'dra bas go mtshams med par gtams par bsgom/ de nas snying gi nang du bh+rāṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang sor bzhi pa gcig bskyed/ de'i sgo srung rta mgrin yab yum gyis byas pa shar gyi sgo gcig pa'o/ /de'i steng du ma las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte ba la hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mtha' ma kī la ya skra shad tsam gyis bskor bar bsam zhing*/ de ni 'chi med srog gi lung zhes kyang bya | thugs ye shes bsgom pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /de nas yum bskyed pa ni lus dang grib ma'i tshul te/ dī ba tā tsa kra zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa dang*/ yab kyi g.yon gyi cha la brten nas bzhugs pa sku mdog sngon mo/ g.yas gri gug gam dril bu/

g.yon rak+ta 'dzin pas yab la stobs pa/ rgyan yab dang 'dra ba/ 'khyud pa'i tshul du bsgom mo/ /de yang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed do/ /de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis brjod de/ 'khor bdag nyid kyis gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas thabs kyi spyod pas zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig brjod do/ /bdag kyang byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gis gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum bskyed pa'am/ yang na mi bskyed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje bdag yin par nga rgyal bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swabhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ// zhes gsung byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ | zhes pas thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dpral bar badz+ra he ru ka yab yum bsam mo/ /de bzhin du/ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na krodhī shwa ri trām̐/ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri hrī/ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri aḥ bud+dha shrī he ru ka budhā kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ zhes brjod pas rna ltag gi g.yas nas brtsams te/ spyi bo'i bar du rigs lnga yab yum gyi mtshan te dbang blang ba'o/ /des ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa bstan pa'o/ /da ni phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya ste | yab yum thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems las/ ma dmar mo nyi shu las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyi shur gyur te/ de'ang rim pa gnyis pa nas gru chad dang glo 'bur la spro/ yab yum gyi byang sems las kyang phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu rdo rje rtse gsum shel brag dkar por bltams pa'i steng du/ de nas yang byang sems las dzaḥdamar po las lcags kyu dmar po grangs med pa 'phros te/

yang shar phyogs nas brgya byin pho mo'i snying ga nas bzung nas/ in+d+rā ya dzaḥzhes pas shar du brgya byin pho mo byi bcings su bsnol ba'i gdan bting ngo | | de ltar ag+na ye dzaḥzhes pas shar lho me lha pho mo/ ya mā ya dzaḥzhes pas lho ru gshin rje pho mo/ ru drā ya dzaḥzhes pas lho nub tu srin po pho mo/ ba ru ṇā ya dzaḥzhes pas nub tu chu lha/ bā ya be dzaḥzhes pas nub byang du rlung lha/ ku be rā ya dzaḥbyang du gnod sbyin/ bhū tā ya dzaḥzhes byang shar du dbang ldan/ sūr+ya tsan+d+rā ya dzaḥsteng du nyi ma zla ba/ a dhi pa ta ye dzaḥ'og tu sa bdag pho mo bting ngo*/ /sti ra baṃ zhes pas gnas yul gyi ma mo sgo ma la zhing rkyang pa re gding ngo*/ /dbang phyug ma la dar gyi gdan re gding ngo*// phyag len du skabs 'dir khro bo'i gdan kyi skabs su 'ding na khro bo bcu dang 'dra/ gnas kyi yul gyi ma mo la zhing rkyang rang las mi bzhed do/ /de nas oṃ bzhis gsang ba'i yum bzhi bskyed/ phyag len du 'og tu bskyed do/ /de nas byang sems 'phros pa las ha brgyad he brgyad kyis gnas yul gyi ma mo bskyed nas/ de nas khro bo bskyed do/ /phyag len du bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo hūm̐ kā ra bton to/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra gardza ga rdza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod tsam gyis steng gi rtsebs la nyi zla pho mo'i steng du hūm̐ kā ra bskyed do/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lus dang grib ma'i tshul du yum sgra 'byin mas 'khril bar bsgom/ badz+ra mut+ka ra zhes pas g.yas kyi gshog 'degs la phag gi mgo can dkar po g.yas na tho ba thogs pa bskyed/ badz+ra sha mut+ka hoḥzhes pas yab kyi gshog 'degs yin la/ rmigs bu'i mgo can dmar po | g.yas na dril bu thogs pa bskyed do/ /de yang hūm̐ kā ra ni sku mdog sngo skya/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ g.yas par mda'/ g.yon par gzhu/

yum g.yas pa dril bu/ g.yon pad+ma rak+tas bkang ba'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rkyen byas te stobs po che bskyed do/ /de'ang shar du rnam par rgyal ba dkar po g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /stag gi mgo can g.yas rdo rje thogs pa dang*/ bya rgod mgo can g.yas lcags kyu thogs pa'o/ /lhor gshin rje gshen sngon po g.yas be con bsnams pa'o/ /shwa ba'i mgo can g.yas dgra sta/ 'ug pa'i mgo can g.yas zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po g.yas rdo rje lu gu rgyud bsnams pa'o/ /byi la'i mgo can g.yas sbrul zhags/ pu shud mgo can g.yas rnga yab thogs pa'o/ /byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram | seng ge'i mgo can g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ pha wang gi mgo can g.yas me sgraun thogs pa'o/ /shar lhor dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug to/ bya rog mgo can g.yas me dbal bsnams pa'o/ /lho nub tu mi g.yo ba sngon po g.yas ral gri | gzig gi mgo can g.yas ral gri/ khwa'i mgo can g.yas lcags kyu thogs pa'o | | nub byang du gzhan gyis mi thub pa sngon po g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'o || spyang ki'i mgo can g.yas na ba dan thogs pa dang*/ khra'i mgo can g.yas na bya khra thogs pa'o/ /byang shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal sngon po g.yas na lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /dred mo'i mgo can g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa'o | | sre mo'i mgo can g.yas lcags kyu thogs pa'o/ /'og tu stobs po che dud kha g.yas pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'o/ /dom gyi mgo can g.yas tri shū la thogs pa dang*/ byi ba'i mgo can g.yas sog le thogs pa'o/ khro bo rnams kyi phyag dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /tha ma gnyis phur pa 'dril zhing yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /yum thams cad g.yas dril bu/ g.yon bhan+dha dmar po gtso bo la stobs pa'o/ khro bo'i g.yon bar pa dang*/ phra men gyi g.yon thams cad phur pa bsnams pa'o/

khro bo thams cad g.yas dkar po | g.yon dmar po/ phra men thams cad gtso bo dang sku mdog 'dra'o/ /stag la sogs pa'i phra men gyi chibs ni rang rang gi mdog de dag thams cad kyang pho nya mche ba can rnams g.yas kyi gshog 'degs pa'o/ /sder mo can thams cad yab kyi g.yon gyi gshog 'debs pa'o/ /yang sprul gsum grangs med pa bsgom mo | | de nas ha brgyad brjod pas glo 'bur re'i nang du zhing gi steng du gau rī khro mo brgyad sku mdog gzhung dang mthun pa las g.yas zhing dbyug g.yon phur bu 'dzin par bskyed/ de'i phyi khyams la sidha brgyad de/ brgyad brjod pas gau rī bzhi mthun par bskyed/ phaṭa bzhis sgo ma bzhi/ shar gyi khyi gdong ma sngon mo lcags kyu bsnams pa/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa can/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma dmar mo seng ge'i gdong can/ byang du dril bu ma ljang gu 'am khro mo ske ga'i gdong pa can no/ /de thams cad kyi g.yon du phur bu bsnams pa bskyed | bh+yo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis me ri'i nang na tshur gzhal yas khang la lta ba'i dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad rigs dang mthun par bskyed/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod 'bar bar sha za mkha' 'gro bsam/ srung ma bcu gnyis kyang gzhal yas khang gi zur bzhi na gsum gsum bsam mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis po kun kyang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed do/ /de thams cad kyang sprin dpung tsam ste rlung gis kyang mi thar bar bsam mo/ /nang du gsang ba'i yum bzhi ni dmar mo ste/ mdun du karma lu ka chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan can/ rā ga sa ma ste mda' gzhu 'dzin ma/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dpral ba la ni rtse gsum bsnams pa | ghaṇ+ḍa dza la ste dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar bskyed pa de'ang ma mo rnams ma yin pa/ khro bo rnams ni dur khrod kyi chas tshang ba'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan ni thams cad la'o/ /da ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te bstim la/

skye med rnam dag ces pa nas bzhengs zhes pa'i bar du brjod do/ /chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs par bskul lo/ / de nas dbus kyi mthing nag ces pa nas karma kī la zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ thams cad kyang rigs lngar bzhengs te/ de thams cad kyang sras mchog phur pa'i sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug smad phur bu'i rnam par bsgrub bo/ /de nas dī ba tā tsa kra zhes pa nas hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i bar du brjod do/ /phur bu'i sku zhig tu byas la bstod/ de nas kyang hūm̐ mdzad ces pa nas/ bzhengs shig gi bar gyis chos sku las longs sku khro bor bzhengs so/ /de nas ta kṛ ta zhes pa nas/ dngos grub stsol gyi bar brjod do/ khro bo de rnams kyang phur bu'i sku sras mchog tu bsgrub bo/ /de nas ye shes pa de la dam tshig pas phyag byas te khro rgyal 'dus zhes brjod/ de'i spyan sngar dam bcas te bde bar gshegs so/ khyed ces pa nas grub gyur cig gi bar du brjod do/ /bstod cing bstim mo/ /de yang dang po gtso bo bstim pa ni dpa' bo sgeg po zhes pa nas/ kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' gnyis su med par bsam/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ka ra mut+ka ra shwa ra zhes pa la sogs pa brjod de/ gsang ba'i yum bzhi skad cig gis bskyed la/ gtso bo la bstims pas g.yas dang g.yon dmar ste/ g.yas ljang nag dang g.yon dmar nag dbus mthing nag tu gyur nas shin tu khro bar bsam mo/ /de nas hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin zhes pas khro bo bcu dam tshig pa la bstim/ de nas gau rī ban byis zhes pa nas/ dril bu sna tshogs mdog ces pas gnas yul gyi ma mo dang sgo ma gsal bar blta'o/ /phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su rdzas dang yo byad la dgod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa dang*/

lha mo spro ba dang*/ rang la rang ngam/ rigs byed pas mchod bstod bya ste/ dang la bde bar gshegs so nas gnas de'i a'i bar gyis kun bzang gi mchod pa dang*/ phyi'i mchod pas mchod/ de nas rang byung zhes pa nas pañca a mṛ ta khā hi zhes pa'i bar gyis bdud rtsis mchod/ de'ang 'jig rten pa man chad du na maḥsarba ta thā ga te mi 'jug go /de nas bla med mchog ces pa nas/ shrī bhan+dha shrī khā hi zhes pa'i bar gyis gtor mas mchod de/ 'dir gtor ma bsngos pas chog gsung ngo | | bgres po rnams ni gtor chung re mdzad skad/ de nas thog mar zhes pa nas tshig bzhis sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa dbul/ 'khril ba'i zhes pa rnams bodhi tsit+ta'i dar gyis thabs shes rab kyi mchod pa ste/ zag med bde ba'i pū dza dbul | mnyam pa'i zhes pa nas pra be sha'i bar gyis gnyis med bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi mchod pa dbul/ de nas he ru ka yi zhes pa ni rak+ta tshar gsum gyis mchod pa ste/ dang po rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa/ nga ni za byed ces pa man chad khams gsum yongs su sgrol ba'i mchod par bzhed do/ /de nas gru gsum mthing nag ces pas bdag nyid la bdag nyid kyis che ba'i nga rgyal gyis bstod do | kha kha lan bag bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum la bstod do/ / de man chad khro bo bcu nas dbang phyug ma yan chad ni shin tu 'dre gdon drag po 'dul ba la sogs pa byed na bstod bskul bya'o/ /de ltar mi byed na 'dzab dbul bar bya ste/ bdag dam tshig par gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i hūm̐ las e bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍal la dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi lha chu dang 'o ma ngang pas 'byaid pa ltar byas te mdun du bzhag go /de la e'i gzhal yas khang gdan nyi zla pad+ma dang bcas pa'i steng du kī la brjod pas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa gtod la bzhag bdag ji lta bar mdun na mo'ang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su byas la/

rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed cing mgal me ltar 'khor bar bzlas pa bya ste/ de ltar brgya rtsa brgyad nas stong la sogs pa nus tshad bzlas so/ /de nas mjug tu ye shes pa 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim pas bdag 'od dang gzi byin dang ldan par bsam mo/ /'dzab bstod dang la bya'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir rang gi srung ma'i bskul yang bya'o || || de nas tshogs bshams la rtsa sngags sam bdud rtsi 'khyil bas/ de nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhes pas sbyangs/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dmigs med mkha' ltar zhes pa nas hrīḥ'i bar du brjod la/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs/ de nas badz+ra dhū pe nas rol du gsol gyi bar gyis mchod/ bla med ces pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gis mchod pa 'phul la/ de nas 'dre gdon la sogs pa gnod pa che na pho nya bzhi sbag tu bskul/ de lta ma yin na khro bo bcu man chad kyi pho nya btang*/ yang na srung ma bcu gnyis tsam bskul/ de nas rgyud lung bskul yang dga'/ de lta dgra bgegs bkug la tshogs la bstim la/ de nas rnal 'byor pas phur bu gdab/ de nas dum bu gsum du bcad la/ dang po sgeg po dpa' bos bstod pa dbul/ bar du lus kyi zhes pas bshags la dbul/ tha ma bai ḍū ra zhes pas bstabs te

| dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshangs pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing dgra bgegs che ge mo khā hi zhes dbul/ de nas rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bza'/ de nas rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyis longs spyad de tshim par bya'o/ /de nas lhag ma bsdus la lhag chog bya ste/ bdag nyid phaṭa kyis zhes pa nas dbul bar bya'i bar gyis bstan te/ de'i don yang mdun gyi ye shes pa'i thugs ka nas phaṭa nag po zhig 'phros te/ bdag gi snying gar thim pas bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs par bsam/ de nas oṃ badz+ra kī la ya zhes pa nas bh+yo'i bdag dam tshig gi 'khor lo gsal btab la/ oṃ khro la khros zhes pa nas sa ma ya phaṭa kyi bar du brjod pas bdag gi thugs kar ye shes pa mdun du bkod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs pa thim par ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas lhag ma za ba'i bye brag gi dang po pho nya dang*/ phra men dang*/ 'bar ba dang*/ dbang phyug ma dang*/ ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos bkug la mchod do/ /de yang bcom ldan zhes pa nas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags yan chad brjod nas gho ru dras kha chu gdab/ des dbang phyug ma brgyad po dang*/ de la dang po phud kyis zhes pa nas/ da tshur spyon yan chad kyis lta ba bstan te/ de nas mar rim pas khrag dmar gyis mchod/ de nas gtor ma btang*/ brten ma bskyang*/ yar bzlog la ru lu bzlas/ 'brang rgyas kyis bkra shis bya/ ye nas mnyam nyid kyis lhag chad bshags/ bzod par gsol/ smon lam btab la/ dbang bsdus la ci bder gnas so/ /de ni nub gcig gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa rang du byed na thun dang po la mtshams nas tshogs yan chad byas la/ thun gnyis pa la dpa' bo sgeg po zhes pa na mar gyis dkyil 'khor gsal gdab bo/ /yang tshogs zin pa dang thun mtshams kyi bya ba bya/ gsum pa la dkyil 'khor bsdus la dbugs dbyung*/

yang nyin mo'i thun la yang snga dro tshar bar bya/ gnyis pa man chad sngar dang 'dra/ gtor ma nam 'degs res kyis lhag chog yan chad bya ste rdzogs par bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus tsa na dbyug to rgya gram la bsdus pa nas hūm̐ thig le la bsdu/ thig le stong par bsdu ba'i dbang du byas la stong pa'i ngang la gnas par bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi dus su rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o/ /shin tu gdon drag po byung ba la sogs pa la byed na mchod pa'i rting la pho nya bzhi sbag bya ste dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bstod bskul zin nas badzab bya/ de nas ma mo spyi bcol dang rang gang byed bya/ de nas bdud 'dul mched bzhi yan chad bya/ tshogs ma grub na pho nya bzhi sbag btang*/ phur pa lnga byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa byas la gdab pa'i las bya/ mtshon gyis gtubs/ gtun du brdung*/ de nas bstabs pa yang phur bu'i lha dang*/ gnas yul dang dbang phyug ma la bstabs pa man ngag ltar bya'o | | phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /phur bu brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ khro bo bcur byin gyis brlabs pa gsum pa la bzhi shar te gnas so/ bar chad kyi bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir gu gul sbyar mas kyang bdug thugs dam gnad la babs par bskul ba'i phyir yungs dkar gyi rgyal pos kyang brdeg de'i dus su dgongs pa yang nam mkha'i dbyings su e gru gsum 'bar ba yum gyi mkhar byin gyis brlabs la/ de'i nang du phur ba bsgreng ba'i zabs sum cha man chad tsam nub pa de yang phra mo ring po ma yin te ri rab ltar brtan zhing mi 'gyur bar bsam/ de ni phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya/ yang na sgrub pa'i rdzas dang dbang du bsdu ba'i rdzas liṅga'i rdzas dang gdab phur dang bsnyen phur la sogs pa dkyil 'khor du bkod pa la phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /de nas phur bu'i dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab pa bya ste/

dang po rdo rje gzhon nu rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa dang | de nas khro bo bcu'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa dang*/ phur bu rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la sogs pa dngos po dang mtshan mar snang ba ni sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /de ni sku byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas kun gyi thugs kar ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na rta mgrin yab yum/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ a skye ba med pa don gyi gsung yin/ a yig 'bru snang ba tshig gi gsung ngo*/ /de ltar tshig gi gsung dang | don gyi gsung du byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje dpal be'u nas tsam/ de'i chang zung la hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyis bskor ba ni thugs kyi rang bzhin yin pas thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur ba ni/ yi ge gzhan gyi lugs kyis dang la bskur dbang bskur | skus gsung dbang bskur/ gsung gis thugs dbang bskur ba'i rgyu yin pa las 'dir drag po'i las yin pas/ dang la thugs dbang bskur te/ yab yum thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa lhag pa'i byang chub kyi sems de yum gyi mkha' la babs nas dges pa'i nyams su btang*/ slar rdo rje'i lam du byung nas rgal tshigs kyi rtsa brgyud/ yab kyi thugs kar byung nas thugs ka nas phur bu dkyil 'khor la 'phros pas byang sems de hūm̐ du gyur pa'i thugs ye shes kyis | phur bu phar dbang bskur te/ hūm̐ la thim/ de nas yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phur bu'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ de byung nas gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang*/ gnas yul ma'i thugs kar thim nas dgyes pa'i ros tshim nas thugs ye shes su dbang bskur | de nas yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ de kun gyi thugs ka nas phyogs bcu'i khro bo bcu'i thugs kar thim/

dgyes pa'i ros tshim pas thugs dam bskul/ de nas yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ khro bo bcu'i thugs ka nas byung nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kar 'phros pas/ dgyes pa'i ros tshims nas thugs dbang bskur/ de yang hūm̐ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ka nas byung*/ khams gsum gyi sems can la phog pas gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags thams cad bsregs sbyangs nas/ sems can gyi yid thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ de nas hūm̐ dai rnams tshur byung nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas bdag sku mdog mthing ga las dud khar gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun yang dud khar gyur/ de nas yang hūm̐ de thugs ka nas byung*/ yang slar thugs kar thim nas rang gi ljags kyi steng du byung nas phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas la phog pas gsung dbang bskur te gong ma'i go rim bzhin du gsungs pa kho nar dbang bskur ro/ khams gsum gyi sems can la gsung gis dbang bskur nas slar bdag gi ljags la thim pas bdag dud kha las smug nag tu gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun kyang smug nag tu gyur to/ /de nas yang hūm̐ de sgal tshigs kyi ha brgyud nas sna bug tu byung nas sna'i rtse mor gnas pa dang slar yang dbugs dang 'grogs nas sna bug g.yon nas nang du zhugs/ klad pa'i rgyas su byung*/ spyi bo nas 'thon te/ phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi spyi bor thim nas dbang bskur/ de nas yang hūm̐ zhes brjos pas phur pa'i spyi bo nas 'thon nas sngar gyi bzhin du dbang bskur/ mthar bdag gi spyi bor slar thim pas smug nag las le brgan du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yang le brgan du gyur pas/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang khams gsum gyi yi dam dang*/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad dus gcig tu 'dus pa'i rtags su/ byi ru'i sdong po phyis pa'am/ me dpung chen po 'bar ba ltar dmar lam me bsgoms la/

gzod gdab pa'i las bya'o/ /da ni 'di na mar gdab pa'i las bya ste/ de yang dang la srog tshe ye shes su bsgyur ba bstan pa las/ bdag rdo rje gzhon nur bsgoms pa'i thugs kar rin po che'i gzhal yas khang sor bzhi pa bsgom/ de'i steng du ma las nyi ma zhud lo tsam gyi steng du/ a las zla ba me long tsam de'i steng du pad+ma gro rgan glebs pa tsam mam sran ma phyed bkas tsam gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang pa de'i thugs kar rdo rje dpal be'u nas tsam gyi lte ba la hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam la kī la yas bskor bar bsgoms/ de yang so sor lhag chad med par bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gong ma'i hūm̐ de las ye shes kyi lha rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug pa mtshon gang ba zhig tsar gyis byung nas/ bsgral bar bya ba de'i lus bshig par sla bar bya ba'i phyir/ dang la kho'i rnam par shes pa dang phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin pas de rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i sprul pas tshur bsdus la | phyi nas lus dgra bgegs dang lug gsob ltar gnas pa de yang*/ sprul pas tshur drangs la mdun gyi liṅga la pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be shas bstim/ de ltar grangs med par bya'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu thugs kar bsdus pa de la thugs kyi sgo ru shar ba dang rnam par shes pa rang gi snying gar bsdus pa'i sny-ing gi sgo ru shar ba zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pa de yang khro bo'i sku'o/ /rdo rje phur pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma sa chen kyi phyag dpe las brgyud pa yin no// // ༄༅/ /phur pa'i las byang bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /hūm̐ a la la ho/ sa ma ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ 'phags mchog thugs rje can gyi dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stobs bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin rlobs bcom ldan 'das/

/dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das | | bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥrdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang*/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*/ /snying gi sgo ru bsgom par bya/ /snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ / phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dīb+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig/srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha | | ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /nga nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi dbyibs su bdag gyur cig /thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhe shwa ri s+t+wam̐/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhe shwa ri s+t+wam̐/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhe shwa ri s+t+wam̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhe hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhe ti sha bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra u ya ka mu kha he/ badz+ra u shi ka mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha la s+ya ke hūm̐ phaṭa | badz+ra byā ghṛ mu kha he/ badz+ra tra ta mu kha he/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tra te hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra tsa ma ra mu kha he/ badz+ra tra na mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sh+ma na pa ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ha ri ka mu kha he badz+ra u lū ka mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ badz+ra kro dhi mu la ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra byā ghṛ mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ | hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kro dha dzā ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dz+wa la mu kha he/ badz+ra pak+ṣi ta mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sha ya ti hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra badz+re tsa ta mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bā ya be hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra si ha mu kha he/ badz+ra ti ti la mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bh-in+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ta sha mu kha he/ badz+ra na ku la mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+phau ṭa s+phau ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ badz+ra kro dha tsun+da mu ne hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra rig shi ka mu kha he/ badz+ra si ka mu kha he | de nas ha brgyad he brgyad phaṭa bh+yo nyi shu rtsa brgyad brjod do// // skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun// sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras po badz+ra kī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /badz+ra kī la ya dzaḥ shar phyogs smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bud+dha 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /gti mug bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs//

rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /bud+dha kī la ya dzaḥlho phyogs ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rin chen 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /nga rgyal bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir | | mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /rat+na kī la ya dzaḥnub phyogs dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya//'dod chags bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /pad+ma kī la ya dzaḥbyang phyogs ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /karma 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /phrag dog bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /karma kī la ya dzaḥdīb ta tsakra phur bu'i lha/ /dmar po gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste// ral gri'i skra la phur bu'i so/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha rnams ni/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od/

/lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa/ /drag po gyur pa'i phur bu ste/ /btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur te | | gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /oṃ badz+ra kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa | hūm̐ mdzad la sogs ye shes khro bo bcu/ /gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs ma lus kun 'dul ba/ /rdo rje srin po phur pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /ta kṛ ta khro rgyal gdug pa 'dul la sogs/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan/ /'jigs byed chen po khro rgyal yab yum bcas/ /srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol | | srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang*/ /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir | | dmigs med mkha' dbyings dag pa nas/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol | | oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a we sha ya a/ ye shes khro rgyal gshegs nas kyang*/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /thugs rje ngang nyid zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye med dbyings nas sprul pa'i sku byung ba/ /'jigs byed rngam stabs khro bo'i tshul du ston/ khro rgyal sku la gnyis med lhun sbyor ba/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma g.yos chos mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag | sdug bsngal log par 'khyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /thugs rje dbyer med dbyings su sdud mdzad pa/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro mo dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas pa/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*// 'dod rgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/

/ma sring byams pa'i tshul du grogs mdzad ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho pra ti pu ho/ /bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig | spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag gis kyang*/ / byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang na/ /rdo rje rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs/ /dus ngan tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas mdzad dka' bdag gis bgyi/ /byang chub spyad dka' bdag gis spyad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dpa' bo sgeg pa 'jigs su rung ba dang | | dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bzang po yis/ /bdud bzhi rtag tu 'joms pas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra// sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /zhal g.yas dkar la bzhad pas dgod dgod 'dra/ /zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra | | zhal dbus mthing la rngam pas khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas snying rje che che 'dra/ /gdug pa zhal du 'dren pas rngam rngam 'dra/ /de 'dra khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur bstan yang*/ /chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms/ /rdo rje rtse lngas rgyud lnga rab tu sgrol/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar bas nyon mongs sreg par byed/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /ri rab phur bus khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs skur gshegs nas kyang*/ /badz+ra kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol | | zhes bstod do/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra muṅga ra sha ya na maḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga sa ma ya na maḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pra dz+wa la ya na maḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe tsa la ya na maḥ

hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa da'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyem spyang ki khra yi mgo /bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seng ge pha wang mgo khams gsum gsod ma dred dang sre mo'i mgo/ stobs chen bskyod ma dom dang byi ba'i mgo /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs skur gshegs nas kyang*/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos su grub stsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod de/ gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya ni/ /kau rī ban byis dbyug pa sngo/ /tsau rī mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ser/ /pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar/ /be tā byis za rdor 'phyang gnag /puk+ka dmar ser byis rgyu 'dren | | kasma dung dmar khrag 'thung ljang*/ /sma sha mthing nag byis snying za// tsan+dha mchog skye ser lus 'brel/ /'bar ba'i gdan la gshegs nas kyang*// mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /siṃ ha dkar po snol seng seng | | byā ghṛ gnas lta snol ma stag /sri la nag mo zhing ldag wa/ /sho na 'dra ltas mthing ga khyi/ /kṛ ta mgrin dmar rgyu mgo rgod/ /kang ka kang phrag snar mgo ring*/ kha khwa khan rog ban gri nag /hu lu dho rgyu mthing tshogs 'ug /pu shud gdong can sngon mo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bya rog gdong can ser mo mche zhags can/ /nyi zla lcags sgrog me 'bar ma/ /thal byed dril bu sna tshogs mdog | 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bde bar gshegs pa khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyis/ /srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās me tog gtor/

yang dang yang du dag mod kyi/ / 'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang*/ /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pa ni pa na pe nu su ra to ti su pa ra mu ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sa ma yo ta mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā su kha ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ shrī badz+ra dhūp+pe du/ shrī badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ shrī badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ shrī badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos | | ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir | | dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir | | 'di ni sngon gyi dam tshig go /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ / bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la/ / rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /namaḥsarba 'gre/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /'jigs byed chen po khro bo bcu rnams la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi zhes sogs kun la 'gre'o/ khro rgyal sku la gnyis med lhun sbyor ba/ / sgra 'byin la sogs khro mo bcu rnams la/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i khro bo'i thugs las sprul/ /de 'khor la sogs phra men brgyad rnams la/ /mthing ga mchod snyems rdo rje gsang ba'i yum/ /gau rī la sogs khro mo brgyad rnams la/ /sna tshogs mgo brnyan za byed mche gshog la/ /sidha la sogs phra men brgyad rnams la

| | sti ra 'ching sdom 'ching byed dbang mo che/ /pu shud la sogs sgo ma bzhi rnams la/ /dpal gyi 'khor tshogs za byed dbang mo che/ /mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho la/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ khams gsum gdug pa ma lus kun sgrol ba'i/ /skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad la/ / 'byung po thams cad 'dul bar dam bcas pa'i/ /dpag bsam shing gi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi bud med nyag gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi rdo rje re ma tī/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho nyar khas blangs pa'i/ /dpal chen thugs las skyes pa'i shwa na mu kha la/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*/ /'dod rgur bsgyur ba'i bdag nyid chen mo la/ /yang byin dang ni de byin dang*/ /bse byin dang ni phag byin dang*/ /dam can bse yi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la/ /sdom la gnas shing rig 'dzin grub pa'i lha/ /lha dang lha min phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor la/ /nya bzhi dus drug dben gnas srung ma la || rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul//thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod la/ /dam tshig dbang dang shes rgyud gab sbas pa'i/ /nges pa'i lung ston rdo rje slob dpon la/ /sngar gshegs khyad par rim par dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal theb spyan dang dkar mo gang rnams la/ /'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar mi 'bral ba'i | | dam tshig gzungs kyis 'brel ba'i mched lcam la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha/ khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro | | 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ dhū paṃ/ puṃṣ+pa/ dīpa/ gan+dhaṃ | ba liṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ hrī ban+dha khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ thog mar bdag nyid rtog sgom bsgral/ /des na gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya/ /'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje bzhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes bya'o/ /sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rā ga ya/ a nu rā ga yā mi/ bodhi tsit+ta/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo | longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim | | a la la ste dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥshrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra a be sha ya a be sha ya pra we sha ya pra tits+tsha ho shrī ban+dha khā hi/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying sti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcad kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ / dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ta mu dra sa ma ya kha kha khā hi hri da pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang | | gdul dka' mtha' dag gdul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar chen pos ni rgya mtshor bskyil/ / 'khor ba'i dra ba gcad pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥshrī he ru ka ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā a mṛ ta khā hi/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/

/gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /shin tu mi bzad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku | | zhe sdang thugs mchog yak+ṣa he ru ka /ye shes sku mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi don dam thugs la gsal/ /gsung gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /sprul pa'i byin rlabs khro bcu dbyings na dgyes | | sku stod mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /g.yas kyi zhal mdog ljang nag bstan pa ni/ /phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags// g.yon gyi zhal mdog dmar nag bstan pa ni// dbang drag rnam gnyis dus gcig rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /skye 'gro rtsad nas gcod pa'i mche gtsigs shing*/ / nyon mongs log par lta ba 'joms pa'i rtags/ /rdo rje rtse dgu phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /sa dgu'i rtog 'joms ye shes dgu dang sbyor/ /rdo rje rtse lnga phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /rgyud lnga sbyong zhing sku lnga 'dren par mdzad/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags sreg par mdzad | | rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ brdung zhing 'khrol ba ni/ /bdud bzhi thal bar rlog cing dbang du sdud/ /ri rab phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs pa ni// 'gal byed ma lus thams cad sgrol bar mdzad/ /glang chen stag lpags zhing zhen rgyan gyis brgyan// che btsan dpe med khams gsum rgyal bar ston/ /thod sprul sna tshogs 'jigs pas sku la brgyan/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngam pa'i zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong sgrogs/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul gyis dbyings su sbyor/ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs gdug pa 'dul/ /sprul pa'i byin rlabs phyogs bcur sprin ltar gtibs// thugs rje rtse gcig breng breng rgyun du dgongs/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba pigh+nāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ da yum e ka dza ṭā+-i bskul te/ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/

/e ka dza ṭī gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mkha' klong nas/ /bai ḍūr sngon po'i sku mdog gsal 'tsher zhing*/ /in+d+ra nī la ral pa gcig tu 'khyil/ kham kham tshig tshig ral pa me ltar 'bar/ /puṣ+pa rā ga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ khro gnyer spyan zlum 'jigs pa'i sdang mig ma/ /kas ma kas ma rno dbal mche ba gtsigs/ /thams cad chem chem gsol ba'i rkan thog thog /thod khrag rlon chen phreng ba'i sbrul zhags kyis/ /mthing ga'i sku la rab tu mdzes par brgyan/ / zhing chen g.yang gzhis gsang ba sku smad g.yogs/ khrag mtsho tha mar skems shing ljags 'dril ma/ /thod rlon klad khrag bsres pa g.yas na thogs/ /bhan+dha rtse gsum 'bar ba g.yon na thogs/ /'khor lo'i rgyas 'debs za byed dpal gyi yum/ /rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /zhing chen bam ro bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /gzir cing gnon pa brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ / thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i sring gcig ma/ /bar snang 'phyo ba'i me za brag gyon ma/ /gling bzhi kun la dbang ba'i drag mo rgyal/ /srog gi snying po'i don las ma 'da' cig /dam rdzas dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'di sbrengs pas/

/thugs dam rtse gcig bring bring rgyun du dgongs/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ / brda dang sbyugs pa rngam pa'i thal mo'i sgras/ /rak+ta chags pa'i sgra yis g.yab 'dor na/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig/ thal mo rdengs shing 'jigs pa'i bshud glu len/ /bsdigs pa'i gad mo dgod cing khrag chen 'thung*/ /dus gsum kun la ma bsgribs mkhyen mnga' ba/ /dmar gyi dri snom khrag gi ro myang ba/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs la || shwa za khrag 'thung glang po las kyi rnams/ /ye shes rmad byung don dam dgongs pa can/ /gzhan gyis ma bskul nyid kyis zhal 'ches ma/ /dam tshig bskul phyir rtag tu rol mdzod cig /phrin las gzhung bzhin pho nya mang po 'gyed | | dam tshig gzhung bzhin thams cad dbang du sdud/ /phrin las dus la bab bo sring gcig ma/ /mngon sum bsgrub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon/ /oṃ dī pa ta tsakra hūm̐/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ trag rak+ṣa kha mun+ta ru lu ru snying kha rag badz+ra dun dun bh+yo/ hūm̐ ka ri ka pa ta ri/ na bal tshul mo te/ kha dam/ di ta ta tam shaṃ raṃ raṃ kha kha la bag bh+yo/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ /steng gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa/ khro bo chen po badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra/ /dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can/ /rdo rje phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs/ /zhabs drug brag steng nyi zla pho mo gnon | | rdo rje sgra 'byin khro mo yang*/ /'jigs byed chen mor snang ba ste/ / dgyes pa'i longs spyod don dam dbyings chen las/ /sprul pa'i pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /'di phyogs bzhir 'gre'o/ /shar gyi phyogs nas khro chen rnam par rgyal/ /dri za gnon= rdo rje snyems ma khro mo yang*/ /shar lho'i mtshams nas khro chen dbyug sngon can/

/me lha gnon= rdo rje sder mo khro mo yang*/ /lho phyogs khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ / gshin rje= rdo rje dur khrod khro mo yang*/ /lho nub khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ / srin po= rdo rje gtun khung khro mo yang*/ /nub phyogs= khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin rgyal | | chu lha= rdo rje gtum mo khro mo yang*/ /nub byang khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /rlung lha= rdo rje mda' snyems khro mo yang*/ /byang gi khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /gnod sbyin= rdo rje rlung 'byin khro mo yang*/ /byang shar khro bo chen po khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /dbang ldan= rdo rje khro mo gsod ma yang*// 'og gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa/ khro bo chen po stobs po che/ / dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can/ /rdo rje phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs/ / zhabs drug brag steng sa bdag gnon/ /rdo rje bskyod ma khro mo yang*/ /'jigs byed chen mor snang ba ste/ /dgyes pa'i longs spyod don dam dbyings chen las// sprul pa'i pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /dgra bgegs snying nas khug cig drangs | | bh+yo phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la bab/ /dpal gyi pho nya 'gugs byed pa | | steng gi phyogs nas byung ba yi/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' phag pho la/ /mi pho phag gi mgo can zhon/ /lag pa g.yas pa tho ba thogs/ /g.yon pa phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs/ /dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /yan lag chings la skyugs su chug /des 'gre'o/ /shar gyi phyogs= dpa' gtum za byed chen mo la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje thogs= g.yon phur bus 'gre'o/ /shar lho= mi 'gyur g.yag po chen po la/ /g.yas pa dbyug tho thogs/ /lho= 'jug byed chen po sha ba la/ /g.yas pa dgra sta= lho nub= spyod rdzogs gzig po chen po la// g.yas pa ral gri= nub= mkhas brtson byi la chen po la/ /g.yas na sbrul zhags= nub byang = za byed chen po spyang ki la/

g.yas na ba dan= byang = 'joms byed rtsal 'phags seng ge la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rgya gram= byang shar phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'dul ba'i/ /stobs ldan dred po chen po la/ / g.yas pa rdo rje= smyo byed dom po chen po la/ /g.yas pa tri shūl= steng gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa'i/ /smyo byed rmigs bu chen po la/ /g.yas pa rmigs bu = shar= mkha' lding thogs med bya rgod la/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu= shar lho= rigs shes bya rog chen mo la/ /g.yas pa me dbal= lho= mun mthong 'ug pa chen mo la/ /g.yas pa zhags pa= lho nub sbaid byed khwa ta chen mo la | | g.yas pa lcags kyu= nub= 'od ldan gsal bkra pu shud la/ /g.yas pa rnga yab= nub byang gsod byed khro mo chen mo la/ /g.yas pa khra bya= byang = sgrin mo dar ldan pha wang la/ /g.yas pa sgron me= byang shar= gsod byed zer mo chen mo la/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu= dpal gyi pho nya mgyogs byed ma/ /'og gi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni/ /don dbyings sbyor ba'i byi ba la/ /mi mo byi ba'i mgo can zhon/ /lag pa g.yas na sog le thogs/ /g.yon pa phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs/ /dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /yan lag chings la skyugs su chug khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na | | gau rī la sogs khro mo brgyad/ /phog par rgyob cig gau rī ma/ /snying la gzer cig tsau rī ma/ /dbang du sdus shig pra mo ha/ /rdul du rlog cig be tā lī/ / rgyu zhags drongs shig puk+ka sī/ /rak+ta 'thungs shig ghasma rī/ /tsit+ta drongs shig sma sha nī/ /mgo lus phrol cig tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /dkyil 'khor de'i phyi rim na/ /mu kha chen mo phra men brgyad/ /sha la rol cig sidha ma/ /rus pa 'cho zhing byā ghṛ ma/ khrag la rol cig sri la ma/ /lpags chen hrol cig shwa na ma/ /rgyu zhags drongs shig kṛ ta ma | | snying khrag 'thungs shig kam̐ ka ma/ /rgyu tshil brobs shig kha khwa ma/

/glo snying phyung shig u lū ma/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na/ /mthar byed chen mo sgo ma bzhi | | snying nas drongs shig lcags kyu ma/ /yan lag chings shig zhags pa ma | | dbang po sdoms shing lcags sgrog ma/ /rdul du rlog cig dril bu ma/ / dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na/ /dbang phyug la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ khyed kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ khyed kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ khyed kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig / byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ khyed kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig/ 'bar ma'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi dam tshig chen pos rjes dgongs te/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus gdul ba dang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khyed rang thugs dam dus la babs/ /ye nas mnyam nyid chos sku dag pa la/ /ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin/ /de bzlog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos pa/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'das gyur te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang ci 'gal ba/ / thugs rje che mngal khyod la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /lus kyis sdig byas sdig pa ngan du bgyis/ /ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod/ /sems kyis blo nor log par bsams la sogs | | 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ /de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams | | mi yi skyon mthong tsam na rlag par mdzad/ /chags nyams 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/

/bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs tshul bstan pa ni/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor gyi khra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha | | drag por 'byung khyed dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nā na baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo la stong rtsa brgyad/ 'khor la brgya rtsa brgyad/ gau rī dang tsau rī dang sgo ma la nyi shu rtsa re re/ dbang phyug ma la bdun bdun dbul lo/ /'dzab bstod do/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs pas/ /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa la/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes phung po mkha' 'dra ba/ /sprul sku kun gyi 'byung gnas che/ /chos rnams kun gyi bdag po ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ /rngam pa'i zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug sgrogs shing*/ /seng ge'i nga ros kyang ni bskyod du med/ /thugs rje chen po thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa/ /dpal chen khro rgyal brtse phyir gshegs su gsol | | snyems pa mi mnga' stobs bcur shugs ldan zhing*/ /ma 'dres sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs rdzogs sku/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol | | oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ oṃ shrī badz+ra dhū pa/ puṣ+pa/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ rdo rje bdug pa mas ni mchod byas shing*/ /rdo rje rab tu gsang ba'i glu blangs nas/ /rdo rje rab tu dga' ba'i gar byas te/ /rnal 'byor tshogs chen dag la rol du gsol/ /lha mo brgyad des 'gre/ rin chen me tog ma/ pad+ma mar me ma/ las kyi dre chab ma/ sgegaphreng | glu/ gar ma/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/

/ dam tshig gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+phau ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dgra bgegs tshogs la bstim la bsgral te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na sarba sha trūn nā sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ka zhes tshogs la phul bas phur pa gdab/ dgra bgegs bsgral te/ 'dre gdon che na/ dpal chen nas/ dam can la sogs pa pho nya khro bo bcu rdzogs par bskul/ de nas bdud 'dul yan chad tshogs dum bur bcad la dang po la mchod de/ sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang | | snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bslab pa yi | | gar byas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po lnga/ /maṃ la sogs pa tshe 'phel dpa' bo mchog /me tog la sogs tsan+da phreng*/ /bzang rgur dbul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ti ra ma lus rdzogs pa nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ /ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad dgyes shing mnan du gsol | | bar pa la bshags te/ lus kyis sdig bgyis sdig pa ngan du bgyis || ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod/ /sems kyis blo nor log par bsams la sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ / bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang | | de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsam na rlag par mdzad/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul mchis pa mthol zhing bshags// de nas bstabs pa bya ste/ bai ḍūr sngon po rin chen ri rab la/ /nyi ma stong gi 'od zer bdal ba yi/ /sems dpa' sngon du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od dpung stug po sprin ltar gtibs pa yi/ /'jigs byed rngam stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /za byed bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba yis/ /gdug pa thams cad rdo rje'i zhal du bstabs

| | mi bzad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing*/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshang ba'i ming nas bton pa la bstabs/ de nas lhag ma bsdus la cho ga bya'o/ / bdag nyid phaṭa kyi ngang nyid du/ /gsal zhing blo rtog goms par bsgom/ khro bo chen po tshogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po zhal 'bar ba/ /rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ /bdag dang gnyis su med par bsgom/ khro bo'i tshogs kyi sngags rnams dang*/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dang*/ /slas dang byi mo byi pho bran mo'i tshogs/ /so so'i sngags rnams rdzogs par 'don/ /zhal gyis rang sngags khri 'bum yang*/ /rnam gsum gcig tu bzlas nas kyang*/ /yang na bdun nam brgya rtsa brgyad/ /stong ngam 'bum du dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ha ho phaṭa bh+yo/ zhes pas gsal btab la/ khro bo khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rje khro dpal rngam pa'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i byin rlabs rmad po che/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang | | yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la/ /grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni | | de ni laṅka'i rgyal po ste/ /snying rje'i dam tshig yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin snying rje'i dam tshig gis/ /laṅka'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig /nga ni dur khrod bdag po ste/ /grub pa'i dam tshig yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin grub pa'i dam tshig gis/ /grub pa'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig /nga ni gsang ba'i bdag po ste/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i dam tshig gis | | gsang ba'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig /dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas bsrung zhing*/ /dam tshig rdo rje sgo 'byed ma/

/rdo rje srin mo 'bar ba'i tshogs | | rdo rje'i khar ni spu gri'i so/ /rdo rje'i sgra ni cir yang sgrogs/ /rdo rje gzugs ni 'jigs byed ma/ /dam tshig ha ha'i sgra sgrogs rnams/ /rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rdo rje lcam dral bsrung ba dang*/ /rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod/ /ces dmar gyi ar+ghas mchod do/ /de nas rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi phyir byung la/ dpal gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs shing mchod pa bya ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pho nya mo/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la/ /pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /gzi ldan 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phro can/ /dkar por 'phros pas dmar por 'khyil/ /dmar por 'phros pas dkar por 'khyil/ /phar 'khyil tshur 'khyil byin rlabs las/ / sprul pa'i pho nya byung ba ni/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi pho nya mo/ /gser gyi seng ge rngam khri la/ /mi mo seng ge'i tshul can zhon/ /mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma/ /lag pa la la rdo rje 'chang*/ /lag pa la la lcags kyu 'dren/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/

/stong khams khyab par sprul byed ma/ /shar gyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol | | de yi bka' nyan pho nya ni/ /dung gi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ /g.yu yi ral pa'i cod pan can/ /ral pa lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya lcags kyu thogs pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /shar lho'i mtshams nas gshegs su gsol/ /lho yi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /stag gi rngam khri chen mo la/ /mi mo stag gi tshul can zhon/ / mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma/ /lag pa la la zhags pa thogs/ /lag pa la la sbyin pa gtong*/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ /stong khams khyab par sprul byed ma/ /lho yi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /de yi bka' sdod pho nya ni/ / lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ /shel gyi ral pa'i cod pan can/ /ral pa lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya zhags thogs sprin ltar gtibs/ /lho nub mtshams nas gshegs su gsol/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /dung gi glang po phur 'jigs la | | dung gi mi mo'i tshul can zhon/ /mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma/ /lag pa la la lcags sgrog can/ /lag pa la la dbang du sdud/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ /stong khams khengs par sprul byed ma/ /nub kyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /de yi bka' sdod pho nya ni/ /zangs kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ /bse yi ral pa'i cod pan can/ /ral pa lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya lcags sgrog thogs pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /nub byang mtshams nas gshegs su gsol/ /byang gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /lcags kyi dril rta rkang gsum ma/ /mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon/ /mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma/ /lag pa la la dril bu 'khrol/ /lag pa la la gnas nas spor/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ /stong gsum khyab par sprul byed ma/ /byang gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /de yi bka' sdod pho nya ni/ /g.yu yi spyang mo mgo dgu la/ /g.yu yi ral pa'i cod pan can/ /ral pa'i lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya dril thogs sprin ltar gtibs/

/byang shar mtshams nas gshegs su gsol/ /'og gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /lcags kyi byi ba chen mo la/ /mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon/ /ngo ni rnga tsam rgya long mig /spu gri'i so la spu gri'i skra/ kha brgya nas ni khus 'debs shing*/ /mig brgya zlog ste lta bar byed/ /lha srin sde brgyad phung byed cing*/ /'og gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /steng gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /lcags kyi spyang ki brgyad khri la/ / lcags kyi bya khra chen mo zhon/ /skya rings lus la dgu tshigs bskor/ /gnam phyed gos gyon nyi zla bskor/ /sa phyed stan 'ding klu zas gang*/ /mig gi ( na ི ) nyi zla 'khyil 'dra ba/ /nyi zla gza' skar sku la brgyan/ /steng gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /pho nya'i tshogs chen rab 'jigs la/ /kun kyang ral pa 'bar ba la/ /lcags kyu dgra sta rab thogs shing*/ /stag gi mgo dang mjug ma la | | he dang phaṭa kyi rngam stabs can/ /zhing chen yan lag 'dzin pa ste/ / 'jig rten khams ni kun la dbang*/ /bar snang khams na rgyu ba ste/ /g.yon pa'i lcags kyus snying nas 'dren/ /g.yas pa'i sta gris nges par 'joms/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /'jig rten ma 'das pho nya la/ /gzugs ni cir yang ma nges te/ /stong khams khyab pa'i lus can ma/ /lus gcig ma la mgo brgya ma/ /mgo brgya ma la spyan stong ma/ /zhal gcig ma la so stong ma/ /glog stong 'bar ba'i kha rlangs can/ khrag dang thal ba'i thig les brgyan/ /ske rags zhing chen ba su dang*/ /gser gyi slog pa gos su gyon/ /pro dza añja rgyan du byas// gcer bu 'bar ba'i tshogs chen la/ /gdan mchog smug nag me 'bar bas// 'jig rten khams kun sreg par mdzad/ /zhing la sdod cing 'thab tshul ston/ / gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bo len/ khro rgyal sku yi zhal du stobs/ /chem chem dgongs la sa ma ya/

/sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pas mchod/ /gang la dmigs pa nor ra re/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na/ /phra men tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ khyab byed chen mo khyung mgo ma// mtha' nas 'joms pa'i gshog rgyangs can/ /dgra bgegs ma lus mtha' nas btul/ /'jigs byed chen mo spyang ki'i mgo /gang la dmigs pa nor ra re/ / gsod byed chen mo dred mo'i mgo | gang la bya ba srog chod cing*/ /'byin byed byi la pu shud mgo /dgra bgegs snying nas da phyung shig /smyo byed lto 'phye rmigs bu'i mgo /dgra bgegs smyo zhing ded la shog /rkun byed chen mo byi ba'i mgo /dgra bgegs bla tshe da rkus shig /gdug byed chen mo stag gi mgo /gdug pa sna tshogs da ston cig | sgrol byed seng ge pha wang mgo /gang la bya ba rdul du rlog /phra men chen mo khyed rnams kyang*/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /'bar ba chen mo sku 'bar ma/ /dpal chen sku las 'phro zhing 'dud/ /'bar ba nyi ma'i zhags pa 'debs | | 'bar ma me khyer glog phreng 'dzin/ /'bar ma gshin rje skar mda' 'phen | | 'bar ma'i srin mo mdung thung 'phen/ /'bar ma'i klu mo lce 'bebs ma | | 'bar ma klu bdag ral gri'i skra/ /'bar ma gnod sbyin khyung thogs ma/ / 'bar ma gtum mo ban glang sna/ /'bar ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang*/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tits+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ hrīḥ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tī ts+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ āḥdes gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags so/

/oṃ 'og tu tra ya/ tro ta ya ha ka ya ma ya bra sha khā hi/ bag shu su kha na bud+dha pra ha pra ti s+t+waṃ bha ya ka dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyus/ /he ru ka ni phud kyi bdag | bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyus/ /ma tshogs dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag/ bka' yi pha 'bab mi gsol rgyus/ khyed rnams nged kyi bran dang g.yog /lhag ma kha chus mi gdab rgyus/ /rje dang 'bangs su khyad par che/ /rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyus/ /lhag ma'i gnas su khyad par med/ /ye shes sgyu mar snang ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /log rtog sgyu mar snang ba'i sems can gnyis/ /ye shes log rtog khyab par bsam yas kyang*/ /sgyu ma yin phyir sangs rgyas sems can mnyam | | ma dang sring mo bu mo'i bu mo dang*/ /sras dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ / bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /dbang phyug nga yi las kyis da tshur spyaun/ / dbang phyug tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /sras dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug ma tshogs ma/ /tshangs ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /'jig rten rnams kyi sreng mo ste/ /lag na glo snying nang khrol dang*/ /mkhal ma khrag rnams snying par 'dzin/ /za zhing phyogs rnams kun tu rgyug /spu gri'i so la skra yegs pa | | mche gtsigs spyan gsum 'bru tshugs lta/ /gang rgyangs sgra 'byin dur khrod 'bar | | bsad pa'i las rnams kun la brtson/ /g.yog mo dang ni yang g.yog dang*/ /bran dang yang bran 'khor dang bcas/ /sngon kyi dpal chen he ru ka'i | | spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i/ /ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /sgrub po rnams kyi las bya zhing*/ / rdo rje byin nas ming btags tshe/ /dam bcas bzhin du he ru ka'i/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /de tshe so so'i gzugs mchog dag /mngon par ston la grub par phul/ /ji srid grub mchog ma phul zhing*/ khyad rnams mngon par ma gyur tam/ /tha tshig zab mo nyer dgongs te/

/rab tu bstan pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'dus pa'i las rnams kun byas te/ /ma bdun tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs can/ khyed ni dri za'i rgyal mo ste/ /chibs su rwa bcu sha pho bcibs/ /dri za yongs la dbang sgyur zhing*/ / gser dang mu tig se mo do/ /ma bdun tshogs kyi gtso lags kyi/ /shar gyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /lho'i phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sngon mo gzig gi sham thabs can/ khyod ni grul bum rgyal mo ste/ /chibs su gnod sbyin srin po bcibs | | gshin rje'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing*/ /gser dang mu tig se mo do | | ma bdun tshogs= lho yi phyogs nas= nub kyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dmar mo zangs kyi lan phran can/ khyod ni klu yi rgyal mo ste/ /chibs su chu glang dkar po chibs/ /klu bran stong la dbang sgyur zhing*/ /gser dang byi ru'i cod pan can || ma bdun= nub kyi= byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /gser gyi 'od zer mda' 'phen ma/ khyod ni gnod sbyin rgyal mo ste/ /chibs su sa le grus ma chibs | | gnod sbyin stong la dbang sgyur zhing*/ /gser dang mu men thor tshugs can | | ma bdun= byang gi= steng gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sku ni bar snang khams na bzhugs/ /chag gang tsam gyis gnam ma sleb/ /dbu ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ khyod kyi srin lag mthe bo la/ /rgyu skad nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'char/ /lte ba'i phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ khyod ni srid pa'i ma mo ste/ /steng gi= 'og gi ma mo chen mo ni/ /ru tra sgrol ba'i mthu chen mo/ /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting na 'phyo// sku ni bar snang khams na bzhugs/ /dbu la lha chen brgyad kyang gnas/ khyod ni srid pa'i ma mo ste/ /'og gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /dpal ldan nag mo shugs sgrol ma/ khab kyi spu la spu gri'i so/ /phyag na bdud rtsi tha ma mtha'/ / zhal nas bdud rtsi grungs ma gsol/

khyod ni nam mkha'i rgyal mo ste/ /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /rdo rje tha ma mda' yis mtshon nas ni/ / sngags tshig g.yab pa'i brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs mchod par bzhes/ /sring bzhi'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring*/ /shar gyi mgyogs ma gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' la khyu lding gshin rje'i lcam/ /lho'i mgyogs ma= dkar sham g.yag thod klu yi sring | | nub kyi= nag mo sder chen gnod sbyin sring*/ /byang gi mgyogs ma gshegs su gsol/ /sring mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang*/ khro dang zhi ba'i las mdzad ma | | gling bzhi sprul pa mang po'i khri steng nas/ /dam tshig can la brtse dgongs la | | 'dir gshegs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la/ /pho nya sum brgya drug cus bskor ba ni/ /tshangs ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /gar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad | | ma sring la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /'bar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ / dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /sngon gyi drang srong ka phywayis/ /lha chen brgyad las ma bdun sprul/ /mdor na sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung*/ /gong gong chum chum las mdzod cig /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la babs/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dpa' mo can/ /bar snang khams kyi mthu mo ste/ /bar snang khams na rgyu na rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs tsam na/ /rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs tsam na/ /me za brag gyon ma/ /bha ga'i klong na bzhugs na bha ga ti/ /ston zhing sha ba zhon nas lha mo par+ṇa sha ba ri/

/nam gyi phyed na rgyu na rdo rje nam gru mthu mo che || ri rab rtsai la bzhugs nas gling bzhi skyong mdzad ma/ /gling bzhi kun byams grags mo rgyal/ /ming gcig ma la ming dgu ma/ /ming dgu ma la mkhan stong ma || gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /bskyod cig ri rab rtse nas bskyod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can ma/ /bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma/ /zangs kyi mi mo chen mo zhon/ / mig ni nyi ma'i zer bas 'tsher/ /spu ni ral gri'i so bas rno/ /sder mo lcags kyu 'bar ba 'dra/ /mjug ma lcags kyu brdegs pa bzhin/ /bang ni glog gis bskyod du med/ /skad ni stong khams khyab par sgrogs/ /g.yas pa rdo rjes ri rab bsnyil | | g.yon pa zangs kyi zhags pa thogs/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ /rgya gar yul gyi pha mtha' na/ /rgya bal gnyis kyi mtshams shed na/ /chu ni bdud rtsi byang chub chu// me tog pad+ma dgun yang skye/ /yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /phur pa'i srung mar zhal 'che ma/ /bse yi lha mo mched bzhi ni/ /gcig ni bal yul mthil na bzhugs | | mar khu'i mtsho la gnas bcas shing*/ khyed kyi bka' nyan 'bum sde ni | | nang yang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du/ /nub kyang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du//rgya mtsho'i gting na 'du 'du nas/ /mthing nag ral pa sha ra ra/ /dbang gi bse khrab si li li/ /ral pa re la phur pa re/ /bse yi ral pa si li li/ khyod ni bdud kyi bi mo ste/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs/ /na bza' ber chen mthing nag gsol/ /brda ni mi phrad lho bal skad/ /skad ni ma go ldab ma ldib// dri ni mi zhim chi li li/ /gzugs ni mi ston lag brgya ma/ /g.yas pa lnga bcu lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa lnga bcu phur pa 'dzin/
