/lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thob/ /badz+ra ku lan+dha ri'i dus la bab/ /gcig ni tsha ba rong na bzhugs/ / zhag gi mtsho la= khyed kyi bka' nyan= nang yang zhag gi= nub kyang zhag gi= rgya mtsho'i gting du= mthing nag ral pa= dbang gi bse khrab= ral pa= bse yi ral pa sigs se sigs/ khyod ni gza' yi= chibs su gza' rta zhur po bcibs | | na bza' ber chen ser khra gsol/ /brda ni mi phrad= skad ni ma go= dri ni mi zhim= gzugs ni mi ston= g.yas pa lnga bcu= g.yon pa lnga bcu= lcags kyus zungs la= badz+ra shu lan+dha ri'i= gcig ni mang yul bse na bzhugs | | rak+ta'i= khyed kyi= nang yang rak+ta'i= nub kyang rak+ta'i= rgya mtsho'i= mthing nag= dbang gi= ral pa= bse yi= khyod ni btsan= chibs su btsan rta dmar po bcibs/ /na bza' ber chen dmar khra gsol/ /brda ni= skad ni= dri ni= gzugs ni= g.yas pa= g.yon pa= lcags kyus= badz+ra tsa mun+dha ri'i= gcig ni gnya' nam 'gram na bzhugs/ /'o ma'i mtsho la= khyed kyi= nang yang 'o ma'i= nub kyang 'o ma'i= rgya mtsho'i gting= mthing nag= dbang gi= ral pa= bse yi= khyod ni klu yi bu mo ste/ /chibs su klu rta sngon mo bcibs/ /na bza' ber chen sngo khra gsol/ /brda ni= skad ni= dri ni= gzugs ni mi sdug lag= g.yas= g.yon pa= lcags kyus= badz+ra kaṃ ka dha ri'i dus la babs/ /de yi las mkhan chen mo ni/ /gru 'degs rgyal mo chen mo bzhi/ /ci byad thugs rje mthu mo che/ khyod ni bdud kyi bu mo ste/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas

| | mthing nag ral pa sha ra ra/ /mthing nag cod pan pu ru ru/ /phyag na gser gyi phur bu bsnams/ /gser gyi rngai+ai'u chung di ri ri/ /gser gyi mdung thung chems se chems/ /gser gyi rna cha wangs se wangs/ /dzaḥzungs la gshegs la sod la shog mgo dang yan lag phrol la shog /dgra bo nṛ dzaḥzhes brjod de// ya phyin rdo rje mthu mo che/ khyod ni gza' yi bu mo ste/ /smug nag 'bar ba'i= zhag gi ral pa= le brgan cod pan= phyag na zangs kyi= zangs kyi rnge'u chung= zangs kyi mdung= zangs kyi rna cha= dzaḥzungs la= mgo dang= dgra bo nṛ dzaḥ= da byin rdo rje= khyod ni btsan= dmar nag= khrag gi= le brgan= phyag na bse= bse yi rngai'u chung= bse yi mdung = bse yi rna cha= dzaḥzungs = mgo dang = dgra bo= phag byin rdo rje= khyod ni klu= ljang nag 'bar= ljang nag ral pa= ljang nag cod pan= phyag na lcags= lcags kyi rnge'u chung= lcags kyi mdung = lcags kyi rna cha= dzaḥzungs la= mgo dang = dgra bo nṛ dzaḥzhes brjod de/ / dpal ldan nag mo re ma tī la las bcol te/ ma g.yel ma g.yel ya gam can || dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum bcibs// rin chen bse yi sga stan can/ /byi ru dmar po'i mthu ru can/ /dra ba dgu yi lde mig can/ /mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil/ /dbu la re ba'i go cog gsol/ /sku la re ba'i sham thabs gsol/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag tsa ra ra/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zu lu lu/ /ral pa dmar po me 'od can// ral pa'i gseb nas skar mda' 'khrugs/ /gshin rje'i yum chen bdud kyi lcam | | 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /dbu la ban dha lcang lo gsol/ / sku la me sgra khra la la/ /phyag na mdung dmar chems se chems/ /nyin bzhin khyo bdun skungs nas sbed/ /mtshan bzhin khyo bdun skungs nas 'don/ /srod la ser mo'i chas su zhugs nas ni/ /rak+sha srin po'i snying 'phrog ma/ /gung la nag mo'i chas su zhugs nas ni/

/dam nyams dgra bo kun gyi snying 'phrog ma/ /tho rangs dmar mo'i chas su zhugs nas ni/ /sgrub pa po la mthu skyes ma/ khrag gi dri tshor dpag tshad brgyad khrir rgyug /yongs bsnyen de ni yongs bsnyen na/ /ma mo khyod lha ma yin te/ /sha za srin mo bu mangs kyang*/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung*/ /yang bcol de ni yang bcol na/ /ma mo khyod lha ma yin te/ /laṅka srin po mgrin bcu yang*/ /ma ltar byams shing pha ltar gdung*/ /bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi la las bcol te | gang la dmigs pa len par byed/ /nag mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /nyams pa'i khrag 'thung dbang mo che/ /srin mo khrag 'thung yin pa ste/ /srod la dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dang po pad+ma 'byung gnas bka'/ /bar du rdo rje bdud 'joms bka'/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag 'bod bka'/ /bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi ni/ /nag mo nam gyi phyed na rgyu/ /nag mo zhag gi ral pa can/ /srin mo zhag 'thung yin pa ste/ / nyams pa'i khrag 'thung dbang mo che/ /bstan pa 'jigs par byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i khrag 'thung dbang mo che/ /nam phyed dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dang po pad+ma= bar du rdo rje= da lta rnal 'byor= bcol ba'i= bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi ni | | rdo rje nag mo nyi ma'i zer la rgyug /nag mo dung gi ral pa can/ /nyams pa'i khrag 'thung dbang mo che/ /srin mo khrag 'thung yin par grags/ /nyi zer dgra bo'i brla 'gugs ma/ /srin mo phor thogs yin pa ste/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo'i bla khug cig /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dang po pad+ma= bar du rdo rje= da lta rnal 'byor = bcol ba'i= bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi ni/

/rdo rje nyi ma grib so rgyug /grib so rta ru zhon nas dgra bo rtsad nas gcod/ /nag mo zangs kyi ral pa can/ /nyams pa'i khrag 'thung dbang mo che/ /sring mo gzhong thogs yin pa ste/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dang po pad+ma 'byung gnas bka'/ /bar du rdo rje bdud 'joms bka' | | da lta rnal 'byor bdag 'bod bka'/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bdul 'dul nag mo mched bzhi yang*/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /gang zhig nyams pa'i khrag la rol/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma'i tshogs/ /bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /'dir byon dam skongs bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bdag nyid rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong*/ / gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang*/ /byang gi 'brog chen rdo rje 'du ma dang*// gung thang tha la'i la thog tu/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /gser chen mkha' la lding ba'i rdo rje klu mo rgyal/ kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum | | sman ri rab 'byams rdo rje grags mo rgyal/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i byang ngos su/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*/ /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo gsil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman btsun chen mo khyed rnams kyis/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /'dir byon dam skongs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yo che zhing chen mo khyed rnams kyang*/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /bshes gnyen laṅka dpal brtsegs kyis/ /shar phyogs rgya yul gtan zangs su/ /a su ra yi brag phug tu/ /zhing chen bsgral ba'i gdan stings su/ /bdud rtsi dmar gyi mchod pa bkram/ /lag tu rdo rje gtad nas ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag

/thar pa thob pa'i ming yang btags | | ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas kyis/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub pa po/ /dam bcas de las ma 'da' cig | dam bcas de las 'das gyur na/ khro bo yak+ṣa 'bar ba yis/ /snying gi dkyil nas ha drangs nas/ /lus srog thal bar song ba re/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub skor bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo | | phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las dum bu'i rgyud 'di phyung nas/ au ḍ+yan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga 'di la don gnyis te/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /de la yang bsnyen pa dang*/ bsnyen bsgrub sbrag ma gnyis las/ bsnyen bsgrub sbrags ma'i tshul 'di brjod par bya ste/ de la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rdzas bsog pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ bshags pa bya zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de la dang po gnas brgyan te/ rten bkram la ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma mdun | rak+ta g.yas/ phud g.yon/ bsnyen phur mdun/ rnge'u chung dang dril bu gang bder bsham mo/ /mtshams gcad pa ni/ khro bo bcu'i sngags kyis srung 'khor brtan par bsgoms la/ mtshams rgyas bsdus gang rung ba bcad do/ / gsum pa ci shes pa'i bshags pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang | skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang*/ byin dbab pa dang*/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma oṃ lnga las 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab bo/ /phud oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ rak+ta ram̐ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rnga dang dril bu la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems su byin gyis brlab bo/

/phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa sngon du 'gro ba'o || dngos gzhi la gsum/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ dkyil 'khor gsum/ mchod pa gsum mo/ /dang po la gsum las/ dbang po rdo rje zhes pas stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ khros pa zhe sdang gcod kyis snying rje chen por bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' stong pa la hūm̐ bsgom pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni/ dang po ni mtshon chen sngon po zhes pas hūm̐ de las 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa bskyed pa bstan no/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar | | zhes pa nas/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ de gzhal yas khang gi nang du phab pa las gtso bo bskyed pa man chad kyis rdo rje gzhon nu rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sems dpa' sum brtsegs tu bsgom pa ni/ snying gi sgo ru shar ba dang*/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan te/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs nas ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ / zhes pa la sogs pas bstan no/ /brtan pa'i yan lag tu dbang bskur ba ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro ba'i don/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan no/ /de nas gnyis pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngags re brjod pas drag po'i lha brdzus skyes su byung ste/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra zhes pas yab/ hūm̐ zhes pas yum | gardza gardza gnyis kyis phra men/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis de rnams bskul te/ de bzhin du thams cad bskyed par bya'o/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhar la dam can dang brtan ma dang chos skyong rnams sprin 'thibs pa ltar bsgom mo/ /phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni byin brlabs byas pa'i phur pa lag tu blangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang dang mthu rtsal dang byin gyis rlabs kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/

mgo'i phyogs bzhi spyi gtsug ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + dang ) lnga dang | sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su gtugs shing rtsa sngags bzlas pa dang*/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do/ /de ni dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gsum mo/ /gsum pa mchod pa gsum ni/ bdud rtsi gtor ma rak+ta dang de la dmigs te/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /ces pa la sogs pas mdun du bdag 'dra ba'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor gcig zhal phye la bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis ka la bdud rtsis mchod la pho nya bskul ba spy-ir bstan no/ /de nas rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ bsgral pa'i mchod pa yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ces pa la sogs pas bskul te dgra bgegs ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la/ oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ la sogs kyis btab la/ bsgral te rak+tas mchod/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /zhes pas bskul/ hūm̐ pha ( ¡¶ lu ¡· pa ) ra bid+ya la sogs kyis bsgral ba'i shas mchod/ pho nya bran dang bka' nyan zhes pa la sogs kyis bskul te/ ha na ha na badz+ra la sogs kyis bsgral la/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' la sogs pas bskul/ hūm̐ ma ma ba shām̐ la sogs pa dang*/ 'og gi sarba a na ya sogs sbrel te de la sogs pas bsgral la klad pas mchod de/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /la sogs pas bskul la/ ¡Ã kha taṃ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· kha thaṃ ) nas phaṭa gsum yan chad kyis gtun du dgra bgegs brdungs pas bsgral la/ rus pa'i mchod pas mchod/ rak+ta'i mchod pa de rnams thams cad la dngos su gtor ma'i dbal gyi steng du rak+ta sbraing zhing mchod par bya'o/ /sha dang klad pa rus pa'i mchod pa yang*/ dngos su rak+ta sbrai+engs pas rak+ta'i mchod pa bya'o | | don gyis bsgral ba'i mchod pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs pa des mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes mchod/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· brjod ) des lha thams cad dgyes nas ha ha ha zhes gsung bar bsam | | hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung nas bdag la byin gyis rlob par bsam/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces pas dgra bgegs bsgral bar bsam/ de chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam mo/ /chos nyid kyi bden pa man chad ni gdab pa bskyar ba'i gzhung ngo | | de nas bstod pas bstod la bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag dang mdun na mo gnyis ka'i 'od 'phro 'du dang bzlas rogs byed pa lha dang mchod pa dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ting nge 'dzin bya'o/ /mjug gi chos gsum ni gdab pa dang | tshogs dang las mjug go /dang po gdab pa ni shog bu la khrag dang dug gis dgra bgegs kyi ling ga rgyas par bris la/ de la dgug gzhug mang du byas la brub khung du bcug la lag pas phur bu thogs la/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /man chad bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhin byas te/ tshigs bcad brjod pa'i dus su pho nya dgye zhing ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + mchod ) dgug gzhug bya/ sngags brjod pa'i dus su phur bus gdab ste/ khrag dang sha dang klad pa dang rus pa'i mchod pas mchod de/ de nas bag zan dang bgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa la sogs pa las byas pa'i liṅga sngar bzhin gyi cho ga byas la/ dum bur gtubs la gtor ma la dbul lo/ /des kyang ma sgrol lam rtog na/ phur pa lag tu blangs la chos kyi bden pa'o man chad brjod cing*/ kī la ya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur pa btab par bsams la/ liṅga'i snying gar phur bu gdab bo/ /rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skye bar bsam mo/ /de dag gi byin rlabs kyis bdag tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas tshogs ni yang snga ma bzhin du byas la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ro de 'dod yon lngar sprul la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi*/ zhes pas lha la 'bul/ ha ha ha zhes pas bzhad/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bdag la dngos grub stsal/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba chos nyid du gnas par bsams la tshogs la rol te/ lhag ma bsdus la kha phrus btab la/ phud kyi gtor ma dang bsres nas las byed pa'i chos skyong rnams la byin par bsam/ gong gi bran dang bka' nyan zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa'i skabs la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta bha liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom mo/ /las mjug ni mnan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg bya/ gtor ma zor du 'phang ngo*/ /mnan pa ni liṅga sa gnyan po la sba'o/ /rdo rje me dbal zhes pas sbyin sreg gi ting nge 'dzin te/ las dang mthun pa'i thab tu rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed la | las so so'i rdzas sam dgra bgegs zhal du phul bar bsam zhing*/ ling ro dang lcags phye zangs phye ske tshe yungs dkar yungs dmar nag mar nag dang khrag la sogs pa bsnyen sngags kyi gsham du gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa btags pa'am las so so'i sham bu gdags shing bsam pa des dbul lo/

/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol te lha mi dmigs par bya'o | | gtor ma'i zor ni sgo drung du khyer la/ brtan ma dgug pa dang zil gyis mnan | gtor ma sbyin/ las gzhol/ gshegs su gsol ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams zhes so/ /de nas dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me 'dra ba la/ gtor ma dug thun phog pas dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me lta bu bsad cing bsgral lo | | rlung phyogs su 'gro ba dang bstun la gtor ma 'phang*/ zor lam na dgra bgegs gzhan yod du dogs na lam phye/ zur cig ces brjod par bya'o/ / bsnyen pa rkyang pa byed na bzlas pa yan ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· man ) chad kyis btub/ dus kyi tshogs lta bu byed na gzhung bzhin du rdzogs par byed de/ 'on kyang gdab pa dang | mnan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg mi byed/ spros pa la dga' na gdab par bya/ mnan bsreg mi bya/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu drug song nas mnan bsreg bya'o || dkyil 'khor bris/ sgrub pa byed pa'i lugs 'di mi brjod de/ las 'di nyid kyis 'grub ces gsung ngo*/ /gtor ma btang nas yar log pa dang chos bdag med par bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pas bsrung*/ nang du chang la sogs pa longs spyad/ las bzhi'i bro dang*/ glu gar dang bkra shis kyi tshig mang du brjod/ shin tu bsdus pa'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi yig chung 'di ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung dang phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa ltar don bsdus te/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par bris pa rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /mchod gtor bsdus pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phur pa'i mchod gtor bsdus pa byed par 'dod pas/ sha khrag phud dang bcas pa'i gtor ma dbal dang bcas pa ci 'byor bshams la bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ngam/ oṃ ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swāhā/

zhes pa dang*/ oṃ lnga las 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ āḥlas byung ba'i phud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang rak+ta ram̐ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag tu byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun du dbang phyug pho mo'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mtha' mar oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon dang po me dpung*/ bar pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'og ma gnyis phur pa 'dril ba/ sku che zhing rags pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon dang*/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa khrag 'dzag pas do shal byas pa/ skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa | rak+ta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i cha lugs rdzogs pa'i brdar rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched dang skra dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro bos gtams par bsam mo/ /rang 'dra ba de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rang lta bu tshon gang ba cig bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje yungs 'bru tsam gyi lte ba la hūm̐ chung ngu cig bsam pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /de la lha thams cad thim par bsams nas dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa de dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam ngo bor bsams pa'i ljags las 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing | dbul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di/

/ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ / thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pas 'dod yon lnga phul la | dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥshrī he ru ka i daṃ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho shri ban+dha khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ yang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas kyang mchod de lha thams cad dgyes nas ha ha ha zhes gsung bar bsam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung nas bdag la byin gyis brlabs/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces pas dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral bar bsams la chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas par bsgom mo/ /de nas sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ thog mar bdag nyid rtog bsgom bsgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje | | gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab bam | zag pa med pa'i mchod pa ni/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /pad+mo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par bya'o/ /sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ra go yaṃ a nu ra ga ya me | bodhi tsit+ta zhes pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa dngos ni/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dge /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim/ /zhes pa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod la/ byang sems mkha' nas blangs lha thams cad kyi ljags la bzhag par mos te/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ pra ba sha ya pra ba sha ya/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha khā hi/ de nas rak+ta dbul ba ni/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas

| | dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa mā ya mu tra kha kha khā hi khā hi hrīḥ de bi sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ khams gsum yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral bar bya/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar chen po yi rgya mtsho bskyil/ /'khor ba'i dra ba gcad pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstod do/ /de nas dngos grub blang*/ bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ ye shes pa dang bcas pa bdag la bsdus te brtan par bya'o/ /'di las kyang bsdus pa byed na/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas/ gtor ma yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du yang snga ma ltar bskyed nas | lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bsams nas bla med mchog tshig rnams dang*/ chos nyid du spar ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams dang bstod pa bya'o/ / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sangs rgyas su bsngo/ mdun bskyed bdag la bsdu/ bsrung bar bya'o/ /rje bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris pa rdzogs so// //༈ bzlas pa'i tshul gsum las/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig sbyong du sngags bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ chos nyid skye med du bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nā na bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bzlas pa'o/ /rgyun gyi man ngag jo mo'i gdams ngag rdzogs so//

//༈ snyan brgyud yi ger bris pa rdo rje phur pa'i sngags phra men nyin zhag gcig gis bsrung ba/ zhi rgyas dbang mngon spyod kyi bsrung ba la/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i phur pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du byas pas phur pa'i sku gsung thugs la thim pas phur pa de stod khro bo sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pas phur pa 'dzin pa/ smad phur pa'i dbal dar sngon po'i sham thabs can du bsam/ mchu btsugs la badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba duṣ+ta na hūm̐ phaṭa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so || 'gro na lus la bcang*/ nyal na sngas su gzugs par bya'o/ /sbod gtong dang dgra bgegs la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa byed pas mi tshugs so/ /slob dpon pad+mas rnal 'byor pa'i bar chad bsrung ba'i don du mdzad pa rdzogs so/ / ༈ rdo rje phur pa gdon drag po 'dul byed ces kyang bya/ gzas pa po kha 'ching ba zhes kyang bya/ bzlas pa khri byas na 'grub par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ gnod byed sarba bigh+nān badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ a bar ta ya/ dha ro a dz+nyid badz+ra a se ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra a se ṣa hūm̐ a/ snying khrag ku lu nan/ baṃ tsi ta tsi ta gnod byed sogs mā ra ya hūm̐ rbad/ kha ga ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngas su gru gsum mtho gang ba byas la gnod pa'i ming byang bcug la/ khrag dang nyungs dkar gyi thun bya/ phur pa brdeg rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la bcol bskul bya/ zhag bdun gyis gdon drag po rnams 'joms/ tsher ma can gyi me la bsreg thal ba gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phang lam du mnan pa bya/ phur pa'i gdon 'dul rdzogs so// //༈ na mo gu ru/ rdo rje gzhon nu rgyan gyi gdams ngag sangs rgyas lag bcangs kyi dgongs pa/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ sngon po cig bsam/ 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ tshur 'dus rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs lus 'od du song stong par bsam de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/

chu'i zla ba ltar gsal la rang bzhin med pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ hūm̐/ sngon po rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin de gyur pa las rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi pa dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba bdag 'dra ba cig bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse dgu pa cig bsgom/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed bkas tsam zhig bsgom/ de la hūm̐ pu shud lta bu bsams pa la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas 'bru dgu gser gyi ba thag lta bus bskor ba la sngags kyi 'od zer ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gsal/ des ye shes sems dpa' gsal/ des dam tshig sems dpa' gsal | des sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam zhing bzlas/ stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas so/ /tshur 'dus bdag la thim/ bdag ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de hūm̐ la/ de ha la/ de mgo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de stong pa 'od gsal cir yang ma grub pa la sems bzhag la sgom bzlas byas pas sdig pa thams cad byang*/ bar chad gdon zhi zhing nad dang rims thams cad dang rkyen glo bur kun bzlog go / tshe 'di la rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'gro/ phyi ma rdo rje gzhon nur bdag 'gyur ro// slob dpon pad+mas mkhar che bza' 'tsho rgyal la 'bral khar gdams pa'o/ / snod dang mi ldan pa la mi sbyin no/ /rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje phur pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus thams cad la/ /sgo gsum kun nas rab tu dang ba yi/ /rab tu gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dur khrod la sogs yid dang mthun gnas su/ /stan la bder 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/

/bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi/ /snying ga'i hūm̐ las tshogs zhing spyan drangs la | | na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya tsa kra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ lus dpag med pas phyag bya zhing | | sngags sngon 'gro ba'i mchod yon sogs/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya dang bcas mchod/ /ye shes sku mchog sogs brjod cing*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod bgyid cing*/ /bdag gi lus kyang dbul bar bya/ /bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du gang dag stsal ba dang*/ /rjes su bdag ni yi rang bas | | bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sgo gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams | khyed la ma lus so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems tshogs dang | | nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom dang*/ /so so skye bo'i dge ba la/ /yang dag rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' zhugs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor sngags bdag he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de rnams la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi ¡Ã dpa' bo ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· dngos po ) mchogakhyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems can srid mtshor lhung gyur pa/ /de rnams kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi dus 'di nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir | | byang chub spyod pa spyad byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog | ces pa bcu po rnam dag dang*/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas kun/ / ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa rnams/

/ yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la | | nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por gzung par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas kyang*/ /sems can 'khor bar bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /ces pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa ni/ /lan gsum bar du brjod de gzung*/ /tshad med bzhi ni bsgoms nas kyang*/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyān badz+ra swa wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong par bsgoms pas tshogs gnyis so/ /snang ba stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ /ram̐ las nyi steng hūm̐ nag las//

'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ /ra ba dra ba bla re gur/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar nang du ni/ /bh+rūṃ las ma lus bgegs 'joms pa'i/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu rnau/ /rab 'bar myur du 'khor ba yi/ /dbus dang rtsibs su pad nyi'i steng*// dbang phyug pho mo bsnol pa'i gdan/ /tshangs sogs phyogs kyi bdag mo rnams// bsam bya rak+ṣa'i sngags rab brjod/ /kī la ya yi sngags brjod pas/ /dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog sngo/ /zhal gcig khro gnyer spyan gsum 'bar/ /g.yas pas phur pa bgegs la bsnun/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub phyag gnyis po/ /sbrul dang mi sdug gis brgyan cing*/ /sku smad phur bu me 'bar dbal/ /bgegs kyi spyi bor gdab bsam bya/ /bdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan rnams/ /song shig lha min gang yang rung*/ /nga la bar chad rtsom pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gzhom par bya/ /brjod de gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /rang rang sngags rnams brjod bzhin du/ /steng du khro bo'i rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa/ /steng gi phyogs sogs bgegs 'joms sogs | | sprul dang yang sprul dpag yas rnams/ /me dpung rab 'bar bzhin du 'phros/ /bgegs sogs gnod byed ma lus pa/ /rengs rmugs gnan dang gzir ba dang*/ /bskrad cing bsad pa'i las mdzod cig khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyi/ /lus ni rdul du brlag par gyis/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes brjod de ltar bsam pa'o/ /de ni mtshams bcad rim pa yin/ /gong du bstan pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /chos rnams skye med stong par bsam/ /dharmā dhā tu āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ / chos dbyings rang bzhin 'khor 'das kyi/ /byed po rang sems 'od gsal yin || yi ge a yi rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + tshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/

/bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brjod de lce la bdud rtsi myang*/ /snying ga'i dkyil 'khor mchod mnyes shing*/ /chos skyong sogs la'ang mchod par bya/ /rgyud drug la sogs tshim byas nas/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed byed cing*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub dang*/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /bdud rtsi myangs la dpral mgrin snying*/ /reg pas dngos grub thob bsam zhing*/ /ka ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /gtor ma bsang spyad mgo sgyed gsum/ /yam̐ ram̐ āḥlas rlung me'i steng*/ /thod chen dpral ba rang la bstan/ /na dang go ku da ha dang | | mu bi ra shu ra ma ni/ /hūm̐ oṃ swā a ha rnams las/ /dbus dang shar lho nub byang du/ /mi glang khyi rta glang chen sha /dri chu dri chen dkar dmar klad/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid dang*/ /so sor rtog dang bya ba grub/ /rlung g.yos me spar bskul ba yis/ /sprin ma sna tshogs rdo rje yi/ /lte bar badz+ra kī la ya/ / phyogs bzhir tsakra rat+na dang*/ /pad+ma karma kī la ya/ /yab yum snyoms zhugs bde ba'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs nas/ /zhal du zhugs shing thugs kar zhu/ /yab yum bcas pa 'od du zhu/ /thams cad ro bcud gzugs sgra reg /phun tshogs ye shes bdud rtsis gyur/ /oṃ ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sa ma ye hūm̐/ mang du brjod de byin brlabs nas/ /mdun bskyed rdo rje gzhon nu yi | | dkyil 'khor tshogs kyis gsol bsam zhing*/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ghan+dhaṃ ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dhā khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi ha ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sarba bigh+nā na sha tūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/

gsum mam bdun gyis dbul bar bya/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ / thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba sa ru dhi ra khā hi/ ma hā a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes brjod khro bo khro mo yis/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag rol par bsam/ /'dod pa'i don la sogs gdab bo/ /bstod pa 'di yis bstod par bya/ /hūm̐ sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang*/ / snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu brjid pa yi/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /bdud bzhi gdan du bting bas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /sku tshe yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /zhal g.yas dkar la 'dzum pas dgod dgod 'dra/ /zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ /zhal dbus mthing la rngam pas khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas byams byams 'dra/ / ¡Ã gdug pa zhal du 'dren pas rngam rngam 'dra | | ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gdug pa rngam 'dra/ / ) chos nyid mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pas/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms | | rdo rje rtse lngas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /me dpung 'bar bas khams gsum nyon mongs bsregs/ kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod | | ri rab phur bus khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /sku smad dbal dang bcas te gdug pa 'dul/ /de 'dra'i khro rgyal 'jigs pa'i skur bstan pas/ / kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sman gtor rjes su mchod par bya/ / bsgral mchod rak+ta mngon bshams la/ khro bo yab yum phra men dang*/ /sprul dang yang sprul thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed pa'i/ /dgra bgegs bsgral zhing sha khrag rnams/

/zhal du bstabs shing rol bsams pas || dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa pho nya'i dus la bab/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyi yi gdong can dus la bab/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni de bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang*/ /lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal lus 'di bor nas kyang*/ /rnam grol bde ba myong bar mdzod/ /mchod 'dril la 'di yan gyis chog /oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ s+t+waṃ bha nan/ mo ha ghā ta ya bha ga wan hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥbi kṛ ta badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ badz+ra kī la kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥsarba bigh+nā na badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra dang bgegs dang bdud rnams dang*/ /sdug bsngal sems la mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba'i bdud | | zungs shig rdungs shing rnam par chings/ /rtogs shig sgrol cig dbye bar gyis/ /rings par khug la smrar chug cig /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis | | bdag gi dbang du byas gyur nas/ /bsgo ba'i bka' nyan nus par gyis | | hūm̐ sa ra bid+ya ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhin+da bhin+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ) ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā sha ya trā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥdaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ shī gh+raṃ ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa dz+wa lā sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bin+dha ya bin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo bran dang mngag pa'i tshogs/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /mngon spyod ji ltar nges pa dang*/ /mngon spyod byin rlabs de bzhin mdzod/ /ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/
